meta.description:
[red[]]Note: this mod won't be worked on as much, updates will be slow, sorry about that!

[#FF0066[]]Technology is the future!

[#ffffff[]]A mod about the blackrock division, it's basically PHIGHTING! [#ff5959[]]SWORD [#ffffff[]]DEITIES but it's about the blackrock division instead of the swords.

Create blackrock tokens & exchange it into one of 8 tokens, ranging from [#2CBFA2[]]medkit [#ffffff[]]tokens for healing, [#2B90B4[]]hyperlaser [#ffffff[]]tokens for precision or [#FF0066[]]subspace [#ffffff[]]tokens for technologically advanced builds.

Much like PHIGHTING! [#ff5959[]]SWORD [#ffffff[]]DEITIES, it has interplanetary construction, whether if it's erekir, serpulo or any planet mod, you can build blackrock factories there.
[grey[]]provided the sector doesn't have restricted blocks.

Please note that researching anything in this mod requires the tokens to be stored at serpulo.

[red[]]DISCLAIMER: Due to it's interplanetary construction feature, the mod may be unfair to some, but then again, have fun playing this mod!
